quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the COVID-19 protocols during the 2021 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: at the time, COVID was so insane, you could have a false positive and you'd be out.
quotes.quote: I wasn't in the arena and the crazy part is, at the time, COVID was so insane, you could have a false positive and you'd be out. You cannot see, you would go there, and they'd say, 'We don't know.' And then quarantine, or you can't be with the team. So that to me was crazy because that happened during the finals.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his experience testing positive during the 2021 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I couldn't get out of my room and I said, 'Okay, but I have to talk to Giannis.'
quotes.quote: I couldn't get out of my room and I said, 'Okay, but I have to talk to Giannis.' While I'm in the door, I knew he was two doors to the left. And I was like, 'You know what? I'm just going to wait. I know his routine. We're going to wait like 3:45 or 3:50. He's going to go to the bus. I'm just going to wait at the peephole. And when I see him, I'm just going to knock on the door. We'll talk a little bit and then he left.' But mind you, I'm in my room.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo

quotes.quote: They take one jersey. So you have always have two jerseys every game. So they take the one jersey, they put it in an auction, and the other jersey you keep. quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Giannis Antetokounmpo's injury during the 2021 playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I saw his knee and I was like, 'That is not normal how.'
quotes.quote: I saw what happened. I was there. I helped him get to the locker room. I had a doubt if he was going to come back because I went to the locker room and when he got in the locker room, they told him, 'Stay.' And I saw his knee and I was like, 'That is not normal how.' And he just started getting emotional and everything and that's the moment that I had a doubt like he was going to come back.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Giannis Antetokounmpo's treatment regimen during the 2021 Finals
quotes.excerpt: he did treatment at 8:00 to 10:00 in the morning. Then ice and matrix and push the bands.
quotes.quote: He did treatment at 8:00 to 10:00 in the morning. Then ice and matrix and push the bands from 10:00 to 12:00. And then treatment again from 12:00 to 2:00. And then same thing with bands and ice and that again. And then from 4:00 to 6:00, treatment again. And then he set up again. And then from 8:00 to 10:00, treatment again. And then from 10:00 to 12:00 again, treatment. And then slept.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Giannis Antetokounmpo's 2021 Finals performance
quotes.excerpt: he's not Magic Johnson. He's not Michael Jordan. He's not Larry Bird. He's Giannis.
quotes.quote: I saw a stat yesterday, it might have been like three, four days ago, with all the trades and all this stuff. So a stat, and they ranked it in like the top three. I was like, 'What?' Of course, but we're talking about this kid who is like this kid from Europe, from Greece, who is African descent, was born and raised in Greece and is in America. And he's not Magic Johnson. He's not Michael Jordan. He's not Larry Bird. He's Giannis.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the importance of counting free throws
quotes.excerpt: the counting gives him rhythm, because you know when to shoot. When you don't count, he doesn't know.
quotes.quote: The counting gives him rhythm, because you know when to shoot. When you don't count, he doesn't know when to shoot. So he's getting this rhythm. He's standing there at the free throw line. He's like, 'One, ah, good. I got 10 more seconds. Two, ah, good.' Eight, nine, oof, 10. And he made 17 out of 18.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
